$description: Munch design tokens. Read DESIGN.md first. Every colour has a light and a dark value. This is the only place colour values are written by hand; web/src/styles/tokens.css is generated from it. Chart palettes were checked with the dataviz validator (colour-blind separation, lightness band, chroma and contrast) on the surfaces named here; re-run it after any change.

bg.$description: The page. A pale lilac white at lunch, aubergine late at night.

bg-deep.$description: The top bar, the footer, the explorer's side.

surface.$description: Panels, inputs, sheets, dialogs, menus, the plate.

raised.$description: A step up: chips, hovered rows, empty heatmap cells.

line-strong.$description: Input borders, axis baselines, edges that must read.

ink.$description: Headings and body text. 16.4:1 light, 15.5:1 dark on bg.

ink-soft.$description: Story prose and descriptions. 8.4:1 light, 10.5:1 dark on bg.

ink-faint.$description: Captions, axis ticks, table meta. 5.7:1 light, 6.4:1 dark on bg.

accent.$description: The lamp. The one colour for 'do this': primary buttons, the chosen filter, the plate's highlight.

accent-ink.$description: The lamp as text: links, ghost buttons. 6.1:1 light on bg.

accent-fg.$description: Text on an accent fill. 9.1:1 light, 9.4:1 dark.

accent-soft.$description: A wash: the active filter, a selected row.

problem.$description: Errors, an expired session. Always with a word.

data.$description: Chart colours. Text never wears these; values and labels stay in ink tokens.

categorical.$description: Fixed order, never cycled. Slot 1 is solo orders and any single series; slot 2 is group orders. Cuisines take slots 1 to 5 by their rank over the whole history (not the filtered view), and everything else is 'Other' in data.muted. Validated: light on #fbf9fc, dark on #1e1422, all checks pass.

sequential.$description: One hue, amber, for magnitude (the week heatmap, the calendar). Zero is the raised surface, never step 1. Validated as ordinal ramps on bg.

muted.$description: 'Other', and the rest when one thing is highlighted.

stage.$description: Full-screen year stories. The same in both themes, because a story is its own room. Every pair passes 6:1 or better: text on ground, and the highlight on ground.

display.$description: Headlines, numbers, the wordmark, buttons, labels, chart text.

size.$description: rem at a 16px root. One display per page.
size.title: clamp(1.875rem, 1.4rem + 1.6vw, 2.625rem)
size.heading: 1.375rem

radius.$description: sm: chips, cells. md: inputs, menu items. lg: panels, sheets, dialogs. full: buttons and pills.

motion.$description: UI motion stays under 300ms. The dots are explanation, not UI: a formation change takes 1100ms plus up to 700ms of stagger.
